items.text: Raiders list TE Brock Bowers doubtful Sunday vs Chargers (knee), per HC Klint Kubiak. Had returned to practice earlier.
items.implication: Likely sit; Mayer or others TE stream

items.text: Zay Flowers DNP Thursday (2nd straight, hamstring); Ja'Kobi Lane IR (wrist). If OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: 1 Bateman 2 Devontez Walker 3 Wester 4 Sarratt 5 Moore. Returned limited Friday practice.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated W1; consecutive DNPs then Friday return
items.opportunity: Bateman primary if OUT; Andrews target share boost

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) DNP multiple practices, day-to-day/questionable Week 2 vs LV. If OUT, Quentin Johnston boost + Harris/Njoku.
items.why: Rib injury W1 exit; consecutive DNPs

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of missing 5 games in 2024 on hammy); ran 37 of 42 routes W1. MRI results key; DNP Thursday/Friday puts Sunday vs CIN in jeopardy. Beneficiaries: Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel/Schultz.
items.why: Hamstring pull + history + consecutive DNPs; doctors say not serious but availability risk
items.implication: Sit or have backup ready; Texans WR room opens for flex plays
items.opportunity: routes/targets to Hutchinson Boutte Noel; Schultz TE1 upside

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore ruled OUT Thursday (shoulder/AC sprain); day-to-day, chance but not lock for next week vs LAC. Not serious per doctors.
items.why: AC joint sprain Thursday night; day-to-day

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson: 'I'm ready to go.' Unclear how much he earns vs Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing perfect: AJ Brown IR, Patriots need explosives, strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV/NYJ/CHI/MIA/GB/DET) pre-bye.
items.why: Self-reported ready + Brown IR creates need + schedule
items.implication: Monitor snap share; potential committee breakout

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps) W1, 40% route targets (team lead), 24% tgt share. IND gave 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall range of outcomes.
items.why: Elite W1 usage + soft matchup + Chiefs role

items.text: LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization W1 (tied Bijan), 19% tgt share last 10, 25+ touches 3/4 recent. Overreaction to injury scare.
items.why: Max utilization + consistent volume under Kubiak

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: RB9 util W1, 26% tgt share, all RB RZ touches, out-routed Gainwell by 8. CLE soft vs RBs.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% tgt share from Wentz W1; 93 yds/18 PPG career w/ Wentz. CHI soft vs WRs.
items.why: High share + historical Wentz chemistry + matchup

items.text: LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% tgt share, 13.7 aDOT (3 deep) W1. TEN soft (85% catch, 16 YPR to Jets).
LOVE Dak Prescott vs WAS: 21.3 PPG home last yr; WAS torched 14.5 YPC/3 TDs W1. DAL top-5 total (27), high O/U.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: Matched Kendre Miller rushes W1, 69% pts via air. Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script.
items.why: Split work + Kamara return + poor script

items.text: HATE Marvin Harrison Jr vs SEA: 8% tgt share W1 (5th on team), 0 RZ looks. SEA stingy vs WRs.
